name: bettracker
description: Local-first desktop tracker for daily sports betting wins and losses
author: Victor Li

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
